summary: Read-only audit separates exact complete kit retry pairs, baseline/revised deduplicated counts and paged evidence. Host admin audit alone loads bounded native assignment history; only exact creation-commit fields are known, with unproved evidence unknown. Any decisive review-record VOID can have explanatory release diagnostics; counterfactuals never govern results or gates. Host release-query adapters reuse the validated runtime authority audit with byte/entry bounds: prior eligibility is proved only within a retained replayable time window; ineligible issuers are omitted and missing/damaged/tied evidence is explicitly eligibility unknown. No native assignment history on release paths, no new store/writer/request field. Existing facts and gates remain unchanged.
